description: ProbCons 1.12's multiple alignment of protein sequences (Do, Mahabhashyam, Brudno & Batzoglou 2005, Genome Res 15:330; probcons in.fa), ported step by step from the program's source: pair-HMM posterior match probabilities of every pair (forward / backward in single precision with the program's log-sum approximation; a match state and two pairs of insertion states; emission tables of BLOCKS 5.0 / BLOSUM62, transitions trained on BAliBASE 2.0; upper and lower case alike, other characters at the table default), `consistency` rounds of the consistency transformation P'(x_i-y_j) = 1/|S| sum_z sum_k P(x_i-z_k) P(z_k-y_j) on the sparse matrices (cells >= 0.01), an expected-accuracy guide tree (UPGMA-like: merge the largest value, average weighted by the merged value), progressive maximum-expected-accuracy alignment of profiles, and `iterativeRefinement` rounds of randomized-partitioning refinement (the bipartitions come from glibc rand() at its default seed 1, as in the program). Optional: `preTraining` rounds of EM re-estimation of the transition probabilities on the input itself, `alignmentOrder` (rows in alignment order), the cosmetic gap penalties gapOpenPenalty / gapExtensionPenalty (<= 0; in the program they overflow a heap buffer whenever the two profiles differ in size, so only equal-size merges are verified), `cutoff` (subtracted from the posterior before the profile alignments), `parameters` (a parameter file as text, probcons -p) and `annotate` (the -annot column scores, 0 - 200). Letter case is kept. VERIFICATION: stdout, standard error (parameter set, guide tree, -v lines) and written files equal the installed Debian probcons 1.12-14 on 407 / 407 committed command lines (scripts/alignment/generate_probcons_oracle.py), see probcons_command. totalScore is the natural BLOSUM62 affine sum of pairs (the program reports no score).

sequences.description: Protein sequences (letters, '*'; at least one). Letters outside the 20 amino acids have the program's default emissions.

names.description: Sequence headers (the first word is the name in the guide tree and Clustal output); omit for S1, S2, ...

alignmentOrder.description: probcons -a: report the sequences in alignment order instead of input order.

gapOpenPenalty.description: probcons -go: cosmetic gap-open penalty (<= 0; 0 together with a zero extension penalty = none).

cutoff.description: probcons -co: value in [0, 1] subtracted from the posterior probabilities before the profile alignments.

parameters.description: probcons -p: the text of a parameter file (initial distribution, gap open, gap extension, alphabet, lower triangle of the match emissions, single emissions); omit for the built-in parameters.

annotate.description: probcons -annot: also return the per-column annotation score (0 - 200: twice the mean posterior of the aligned residue pairs of the column, in percent).

alignedSequences.description: Rows of the alignment in output order (input order unless alignmentOrder; letters keep their case, gaps are -).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum of pairs (BLOSUM62 10 / 0.2) rounded; 0 when a letter is outside the BLOSUM62 alphabet (the program reports no score).

exactTotalScore.description: The same score unrounded (NaN when it cannot be computed).

guideTree.description: The tree the program prints to standard error: ((a (c d)) b), leaves are the sequence headers.

annotation.description: With annotate: the -annot score of every column (0 - 200); omitted otherwise.

errors.message: sequences is null or empty, a sequence is empty, or a character is not a letter, * or - (the program: "Unknown character encountered")
consistency outside 0 - 5, iterativeRefinement outside 0 - 1000, preTraining outside 0 - 20, a positive gap penalty, cutoff outside [0, 1]
parameters is not a parameter file (fewer than four lines)

examples.name: Four proteins with the program defaults (probcons in.fa)
No consistency, no refinement, column annotation (probcons -c 0 -ir 0 -annot ann.txt)
